describe: A box scene (PLAN.md §9.0, §8.13): a sim-side scene module on the box room's level with a setting and an entity the page draws, and its replay test: the same hash three times, and its recording replays to the same hashes.
id: the module's path, labs/box/scenes/<name> (its scene id is box:<name>, its URL ?scene=<name>): labs/box/scenes/spinners
next: make it show what its stage needs; keep a replay of it as {{id}}.test.ts's file comment says (x sim, copy to tests/replays/box-<stage>-{{name}}.replay.json, x replay <file> --browser sim --update, then --browser page); list it in labs/box/README.md's Scenes and, for a stage, in tests/e2e/parity.spec.ts's STAGES; then node x docs --write
